title: The influence of agricultural tillage practices on soil biodiversity
author: Robert Hanner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.efmbbk6

steps.title: Trim primers with Cutadapt
steps.instruction: Run Cutadapt on the raw reads (Linux) to remove primer sequences; see https://github.com/marcelm/cutadapt/ for the tool.

steps.title: Quality filter reads with fastq_filter
steps.instruction: Execute fastq_filter with the option -fastq_maxee 1 and trim all reads to a common length for each gene.

steps.title: Relabel sequences with -relabel
steps.instruction: Add sample identifiers to each sequence header using the -relabel command.

steps.title: Extract ITS2 region using ITSx
steps.instruction: Run the ITSx program to extract the ITS2 region from the flanking 5.8S rRNA sequence.

steps.title: Map reads to OTU reference per gene
steps.instruction: Map all sample‑labelled reads onto the OTU file for each gene (e.g., using the UPARSE mapping function).

steps.title: Identify OTUs via BLAST against databases
steps.instruction: Use BLAST to compare each OTU sequence against SILVA_123 (for 16S, 18S, AMF), UNITE (for ITS2), and GenBank (for CO1).

steps.title: Assign taxonomy with MEGAN5 LCA
steps.instruction: Run MEGAN5 to select the most appropriate taxonomic ID using the Lowest Common Ancestor algorithm with a threshold of LCA% 75.

steps.title: Generate tax ID table with search_exact
steps.instruction: Apply UPARSE's search_exact function to map taxonomic IDs onto OTUs and output a table‑formatted file.

steps.title: Statistical analysis in STAMP
steps.instruction: Load the OTU table containing tax IDs into the STAMP program for downstream statistical analysis.
